narrative: Zebrocy operates as a downloader and collects information about the infected host that is uploaded to the command and control (C&C) server before downloading and executing the next stage. It appears that the threat group has now switched from delivering the [REDACTED_MALWARE] downloader to the Go downloader. Zebrocy samples written in AutoIT, C++, C#, [REDACTED_MALWARE], Go, and VB.NET have been discovered by the research community.
